versions.changelog:
- Initial release of douyin-downloader-pro.
- Supports downloading Douyin (抖音) videos and image galleries by sharing code, short link, or full page URL.
- Automatically detects whether the content is a video or image gallery; downloads all images for galleries into a named directory with optional zip packaging.
- Provides command-line usage instructions and handles both video and gallery downloads with one command.
- Implements robust input parsing and fallback logic for different Douyin URL and share formats.
- Documents limitations, troubleshooting steps, and compliance notes for proper usage.
